longDescription:
## What GEOly does

[GEOly](https://www.geoly.ai) tracks how brands are mentioned and cited across AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, Google AI) — the GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) analytics layer for the AI-search era.

After connecting your GEOly account, any agent can:

- **Measure AI visibility**: brand overview KPIs (AIGVR, mention rate, citation rate), daily trends, per-prompt drill-down
- **Trace citations**: which URLs and domains AI engines cite when answering questions in your space
- **Benchmark competitors**: record-weighted competitor matrices and head-to-head public brand comparison
- **Find opportunities**: category whitespace, brand momentum, AI search query demand, topic competition difficulty
- **Audit AI readiness**: site audit results across accessibility, structured data, content structure and technical checks

## Requirements

A GEOly account ([sign up](https://www.geoly.ai)). Public / industry intelligence tools require a Grow-tier-or-above plan. The bundled `geoly-geo` skill keeps the agent on the correct metric caliber so quoted numbers match the GEOly app.
